mapper.select: SELECT ur.role_id AS roleId, ds.action AS action, ds.data_scope AS dataScope FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND rp.permission_code = #{action} LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_scope ds ON ds.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ds.role_id = ur.role_id AND (ds.action = #{action} OR ds.action IS NULL) WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ds.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sys_role_data_scope ds ON ds.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ds.role_id = ur.role_id AND ds.action IS NULL WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
